What does the Hampton Club fee include for Hampton Cove townhome owners?

Townhome strata lots in Polygon's Hampton Cove community share access to the private 12,000+ sq ft Hampton Club facility, which includes an outdoor heated pool, spa, gymnasium, fitness studio, lounge, and guest suites for visiting relatives.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Ladner townhomes?
Monthly strata fees for Ladner townhomes generally run between $310 and $540 depending on unit entitlement, complex age, landscaping coverage, and clubhouse amenities.
Do Ladner townhomes have tandem or side-by-side garages?

In newer 3-storey Hampton Cove townhouses, interior units typically use two-car tandem garages while end units and wider floorplans offer side-by-side two-car garages. Older 2-level complexes in central Ladner frequently feature side-by-side garages or double carports.
Which public schools serve Hampton Cove and central Ladner townhomes?

Hampton Cove townhomes fall within the Neilson Grove Elementary catchment, while central Ladner townhomes fall within Ladner Elementary, Hawthorne Elementary, or Holly Elementary; all feed into Delta Secondary School (SD37).
Are pets and rentals permitted in Ladner townhome complexes?

Yes. Standard residential rental restrictions are no longer enforceable under the BC Strata Property Act, and most Ladner townhome strata bylaws allow up to two pets (dogs or cats). Always verify exact pet rules in the complex's registered bylaws.
